WHO WE ARE

Connected thinking.
Considered engineering.

Neksoft Consultancy Services B.V. is a Netherlands-based technology company delivering innovative IoT solutions, intelligent software, digital transformation, and business technology services.

With a dedicated delivery team of 35 professionals in India, Neksoft combines global technology expertise with practical, cost-effective implementation capabilities.

Our strategic focus is on IoT-enabled solutions that connect physical environments with digital intelligence. Through our flagship product, Fisheries360, we are expanding our capabilities in smart aquaculture, connected monitoring, and data-driven operations.
